help.quick_start_text:
Welcome to Boa

Create or convert a Python file, connect blocks from left to right, then run the project with F5.

The main graph is bold and uses a Play icon. Right-click another graph to run it separately.

Every .py script remains an independent source file; its graph is saved in the neighboring .boa file.
help.controls_text:
Essential controls

F5: run the main graph
Ctrl+F5: relaunch
Shift+F5: stop
Ctrl+S: save graphs
Ctrl+C / Ctrl+V: copy and paste blocks with their connections
Ctrl+0: center the graph

Connection colors

Blue: valid data · Cyan: flow · Yellow: conversion to review · Red: error or conflict.
help.conversion_text:
Python → Boa conversion

Boa validates generated Python before replacing a graph. If validation fails, the previous graph is kept.

Common constructs become native blocks. Rare or highly dynamic expressions remain in structured Python blocks to preserve behavior.

After conversion, always compare the result on your project’s important inputs.

Boa {version}

Project format 10 · Python 3.12 and 3.13 · PySide6.
